paragraphs.text: Jammu Airport (IXJ/VIJU) serves as a key air gateway for Jammu, IN, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 18/36: 2042 m (6700 ft) asphalt.
Ground transportation options connecting Jammu Airport with central Jammu include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from IXJ should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Jammu Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Jammu Airport is IXJ and the ICAO code is VIJU.
